title: A PASS over zero evidence is NOT-EARNED, never PASS
pattern: A check exits 0 over an empty evidence base ("Scope: 0 ...") while product code exists, and dashboards fold SKIP into PASS — gates render green over literally nothing.
groundedIn: docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-pixel-perfect-forensics.md (RC2: phase-graceful semantics with no phase-awareness; worst() collapses SKIP into PASS)

title: Every declared acceptance method must resolve to an executable mechanism
pattern: A requirement declares its verification method (pixel-diff, e2e, ...) but no tool implements it — a spec restating the requirement, or an echo-stub npm script, is treated as chain satisfaction and the build proceeds on a phantom acceptance method.
groundedIn: docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-pixel-perfect-forensics.md (RC1: acceptance method never operationalized; test:e2e = echo stub = green)
docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-reflection-mechanism-design.md (mechanism 2: acceptance-contract auditor, hard from day one)

title: Done-claims in prose must carry resolvable evidence pointers
pattern: Strong completion language ("Convergence reached", "verification-only", "Overall result: Pass") appears in handoff docs with no resolvable evidence artifact behind it — maker narrative supplies the verdict that the gates never computed.
groundedIn: docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-pixel-perfect-forensics.md (RC6: DONE declared by unaudited maker narrative; current-state.md:85 vs :91)
docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-course-field-study.md (rule: convert every cared-about property from prompt instruction into an artifact-existence check with an exit code)
